name: Hall
gaps: Parcels are HallCo_Addr_Pcl_Rds Parcel Boundary (official GHCGIS) (https://hallgis.hallcounty.org/arcgis/rest/services/HallCo_Addr_Pcl_Rds/MapServer/1). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Household income stays the ACS B19013_001E tract join. GDOT AADT is not copied onto the parcel.
A NO_RELEASE flag suppresses owner and mailing fields.
Source query returned 6905 rows; 6904 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 tax is REST, sale is HTML-only, and owner is REST. HTML-only values were not scraped.
Pass 2 sale date and price are HTML-only and were not copied.
Property-appraiser links use each parcel id in the pass-2 template and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
